I, Gayantha Karunatilake, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the land described below is neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.
